description: This Java class manages media playback notifications for an Android music service, updating the notification based on media session state and user interactions.

classes.name: MediaNotificationManager
classes.description: Manages media playback notifications, updating and canceling notifications in response to media session state changes and user actions.

methods.name: MediaNotificationManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the notification manager and session tokens, and registers necessary receivers.

methods.name: startNotification
methods.description: Starts the foreground notification and registers callbacks to keep it updated based on media session changes.

methods.name: stopNotification
methods.description: Stops the foreground notification and unregisters callbacks and receivers.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles broadcast actions related to media controls (play, pause, next, prev).

methods.name: updateSessionToken
methods.description: Updates the media session token and controller when the session changes.

methods.name: createContentIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to launch the media player activity when the notification is tapped.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Builds and returns the media notification based on current media metadata and playback state.

methods.name: addPlayPauseAction
methods.description: Adds the play or pause action button to the notification depending on playback state.

methods.name: setNotificationPlaybackState
methods.description: Updates the notification's playback position and ongoing status based on playback state.

methods.name: fetchBitmapFromURLAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches album art from a URL and updates the notification with the downloaded image.
